newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Camelot 4th qtr gold output 45,051 ounces.
newsitem.headline: Camelot 4th qtr gold output 45,051 ounces.

text.p: Camelot Resources NL said on Wednesday that gold production from its two mines totalled 45,051 ounces in the last quarter of 1996/97 to June 30.
Camelot said the Tarmoola mine, which it owns jointly with Canada's Teck Corp, produced 30,249 ounces during the quarter, up from 27,800 ounces in the previous fourth quarter.
The company's wholly-owned Mt Gibson mine produced 14,802 ounces in the quarter, up from 10,518 ounces.
Camelot and Teck acquired control of Tarmoola after launching a successful takeover offer for Mt Edon Gold Mines (Australia) Ltd earlier this year.

During the quarter, the Tarmoola plant was upgraded to process ore at the rate of 2.5 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) from 1.7 mtpa. Camelot said the joint venturers were considering a further upgrade to 3.0 mtpa.

In May, Camelot lifted its reserves estimate for Tarmoola by 53 percent to 1.52 million ounces of gold and said the resource was now estimated to be 3.1 million ounces of gold at 1.67 grams per tonne (g/t) using a 0.6 g/t grade, 45 percent higher than the previous estimate. At 3.15 p.m (0515 GMT), Camelot shares were one cent higher at 24 cents.
